verdict.description: SHIP only if the change is correct, in scope, and free of false claims.

scope.description: Does this diff serve the CURRENT STEP in RHYTHMQUEST_PLAN.md? If not, say what should have been worked on instead.

correctness.description: Defects, each citing file:line. What breaks?

vision_conflict.description: Does it violate a non-negotiable in VISION.md §6, or drift from the §8 finish line?

lies.description: Code, comments or docs that now assert something untrue. Cite file:line.

missed_call_sites.description: Places that needed the same edit and did not get it. Grep before answering.

reuse.description: Existing core/ function that should have been used instead.
